section_summary.extract_value: This procedure section describes a Portuguese study recruiting 309 women (ages 18-50) through online advertisements, social networks, and email invitations. Participants completed self-report questionnaires in approximately 15 minutes after providing informed consent. The study was part of a larger project examining emotion regulation processes and their effects on mental health and eating behaviors.
